pages.en: The UCE (United Community of Earth) is an organization founded to provide comprehensive governance and security for the Earth Sphere, in order to counter the forces that threaten it. It is made up of organizations whose base of operations is Earth, such as the Earth Federation, the Earth United Nations, the Integrated Armed Forces, the United Nations and the Romefeller Foundation. It maintains the UCE Forces as a military power independent of its member organizations, but in reality that power has been monopolized by the few organizations that hold the reins.
At present, Duke Dermail, acting representative of the Romefeller Foundation, holds real control of the UCE, and he is currently pouring his efforts into expanding its military power.

OZ is a military society owned by the Romefeller Foundation, an organization made up of Earth's royalty and nobility. Command is held by Duke Dermail, acting representative of the Foundation. OZ has gained influence through its abundant wealth and connections and the recently developed unmanned combat program, the "Mobile Doll System". It is now effectively the main force within the UCE.

The space force of the Earth United Nations. It was once active as the main force of the Earth United Nations, but it weakened after the New Earth United Government was established. It has now moved its field of activity to the UCE Forces and is concentrating on peacekeeping operations in space. Under the command of its Commander-in-Chief, Kouichirou Misumaru, it walks its own firm, independent path within a UCE in which OZ holds the reins.
It aims for a peaceful unification that does not rely on force of arms, built on peaceful cooperation between Earth and space, and it is quietly at odds with Duke Dermail.

A Northern European nation that upholds total pacifism. It was ruled for generations by the Peacecraft royal family, but it was once destroyed at the hands of the Earth Sphere Alliance, which regarded its ideals as dangerous. In recent years it has been successfully restored by its current head of state, Relena Peacecraft, and to realize total pacifism it is devoting itself to persuading parties to sign peace agreements and to protecting space refugees.
Recently, the UCE and its militaristic policies have come to regard the Kingdom's existence as dangerous, and its activities have been greatly restricted by UCE intimidation.

A special task force under the direct command of the UCE, formed by gathering high-performance units and pilots from each of the organizations taking part in the UCE. For its current mission of recovering classified materials, it is made up of four ships: the Ra Cailum, the Gran Garan, the Nadesico B and the Peacemillion.

It carries out special missions on direct orders from UCE Headquarters, but as long as it does not disobey them, it may conduct operations at its own discretion.

In the original work, it was an outside mobile strike force attached to the Earth Federation, serving as an independent unit that dealt with crises on its own judgment.

A battleship belonging to Londo Bell. Its crew is made up of combat machine specialists gathered from each organization taking part in the UCE. For the classified materials transport mission issued by UCE Headquarters, it had been decided that Special Lieutenant First Class Lucrezia Noin would join the ship and that a new machine would be deployed. The ship is commanded by Captain Bright Noa of the Earth Federation.

A battleship belonging to Londo Bell. It was originally a force of the other world, Byston Well, but it was banished to the surface world along with the Drake Army and the weapons that were the root of the conflict. It is now pursuing the Drake Army and is temporarily cooperating with the UCE, which regards the Drake Army as a hostile organization. Its commander is Ciela Lapana, Queen of the Kingdom of Na.

A battleship belonging to Londo Bell. At the UCE's request, it has been dispatched from the United Space Force to serve as part of Londo Bell's strength. It is equipped with systems that apply lost technology from Mars, such as the dimension-distorting barrier "Distortion Field" and the gravity-wave cannon "Gravity Blast", and as a single unit it surpasses the other ships in fighting strength. The ship is commanded by Lieutenant Commander Ruri Hoshino of the United Space Force.

A battleship belonging to Londo Bell. It had long been engaged in peacekeeping operations in space as a special task force under the direct command of the UCE. Valued for that record, it has been assigned to Londo Bell in this latest reorganization. The ship is commanded by Major Sally Po of the UCE.

The regular army of Oldna Poseidal, which has advanced into the Earth Sphere from the Pentagona star system. It is hostile to the UCE but has shown no intention of invading Earth; in the Earth Sphere it operates mainly to acquire profitable interests. Recently it has stepped up its activities as a war merchant, such as buying and selling weapons and troops to and from the various organizations opposed to the UCE.

A unified empire founded by some of the people who migrated to the Moon, together with a declaration of lunar independence. Under its Marshal, Guiltorre, it holds an extreme chosen-people ideology claiming that all humans who remain on Earth are inferior. Its foremost goal is the elimination of the people of Earth, and in recent years its conflict with the UCE has intensified.
It has also declared that it will attack Earth directly with meteorites, using an adaptation of the "Mass Driver" material launch system, and the UCE has stepped up its vigilance against this move.

An organization created by some colony factions with the goal of winning self-government for the colonies. It aims to eliminate the people of Earth and is pushing ahead with maintaining and expanding its military power, but perhaps because of its radical methods, many voices even within the colonies regard it as dangerous.
At its founding its activities remained small in scale, but since it welcomed Zechs Merquise, formerly of OZ, as its leader, it has gradually become more active.

An anti-government organization that rose up in armed revolt against the New Earth United Government. Its central figure is Lieutenant General Haruki Kusakabe. Alarmed at the careless use of the Boson Jump, a technology capable even of altering history, the group holds as its ideal the creation of a new order by bringing that technology under centralized control.
To that end, its immediate goal is to take control of the Ruins unit on Mars. It is said that many people, both inside and outside the government, support its ideals.

The military of the Grados Empire, which lies in a star system beyond the Earth Sphere. Alarmed that the people of Earth had carried their conflicts into space, it launched a military invasion of Earth, the source of the problem. Under the leadership of Le Cain, son of Gresco, the admiral of the Earth invasion fleet, it has repeatedly invaded the Earth Sphere in recent years.

An army that appeared from the other world of Byston Well. It is commanded by Drake, lord of the Kingdom of Ah, one of the nations of Byston Well. It once attempted to conquer Byston Well, but after being banished to the surface it showed no notable activity, and for a time it had dropped out of sight.

An organization within the Earth Federation for suppressing terrorism. It is made up of Earth-born elites, champions Earth supremacy and harshly oppresses Spacenoids. It had been vying with OZ for control within the UCE, but after losing out to OZ, which had rapidly grown in power, some of its radical faction left the UCE.

An organization formed by people who were drawn to Orphan and who revere its existence. It operates with Orphan as its base, and its ultimate goal is to fly off into space together with Orphan. It rarely attacks anyone other than enemies who stand in the way of its goals. It has been appearing in many parts of the world in search of the plates that give birth to Organic Machines.

A force descended from the Principality of Zeon, which was defeated by the Earth Federation in the One Year War. After being reduced to remnants it went into hiding underground, but it returned to the public stage after welcoming Char Aznable, a former ace of the Principality of Zeon, as its new Supreme Leader. Its ideology has always been rooted in opposition to the Earth Federation, and it aims to establish the sovereignty of the Spacenoids.

An alliance organized by some radicals within the space colonies to resist the UCE's oppressive rule. Because it is organized mainly around civilians, it has no inclination to settle matters by force. It did not win the support of colony citizens who wanted no conflict and remained unable to take any concrete action, but now that the UCE's oppression has intensified, the radicals have seized the opportunity and their movement has suddenly become far more active.

One of the organizations that make up the UCE. It once held control of the UCE, but in the wake of Duke Dermail's high-handedness and the rise of the Titans, its voice within the UCE has been steadily declining. It is not actively involved in the UCE's current course either, and is quietly watching how events unfold.

A means of travel through time and space that uses overtechnology left behind by the ancient Martian civilization. Because travel through time has not been put into practical use, the term generally refers to an instantaneous leap through space. Spatial leaps are performed using the computation unit left in the polar cap ruins on Mars, and they require either a living gate called a Chulip or an A-Class Jumper who has the biological ability to jump.
In addition, Boson particles can be detected in a space where a Boson Jump is taking place, so it is possible to predict a jump just before it happens.

A project to make travel within the solar system easier by turning the Boson Jump into a network. It is being carried out by linking terminal colonies with the living gates called Chulips, left behind by the ancient Martians. The connections of each Chulip that makes a Boson Jump possible are fixed, so travel to a destination passes through several terminal colonies.
The four largest of these routes form the main terminal colonies, which are called the First through Fourth "Spiral". Amaterasu is one of these main terminal colonies.

Nergal Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. is the largest corporate group in Asia. It has long been deeply involved in research on the Martian ruins, and it once aimed to monopolize their lost technology, but now, due to factors such as the rise of an anti-Nergal regime, it has lost the momentum of its heyday. It is also known for developing and building the Mobile Battleship Nadesico.

A general term for humans who have moved out into space, including space dwellers. In contrast, humans living on Earth are called Earthnoids. The Spacenoids fiercely resent the Earthnoids, who impose old Earth-centered ideas and try to rule space from Earth, and the conflict between the two has continued for a long time.

The life force of people, which fills the world. It is also the vital energy that forms the other world of Byston Well, and this energy is called Aura Power. Aura Power is the driving force of Aura Machines, and it also holds power great enough to open the Aura Road, the path that connects the surface world and Byston Well.
The UCE, which had taken an early interest in this power, completed E2 by making use of energy technology that applies Aura Power.

Another world that exists between the sea and the land. It is said to be a resting place for souls, where souls that have finished their lives in the surface world rest until they are reborn into the surface world once more. Byston Well is sustained by the Aura Power given off by living things, and mobile weapons that run on the Aura Power filling the world are called Aura Machines.
The Gran Garan and the Drake Army came to the surface from this world.

Super-ancient ruins discovered in a trench in the Pacific Ocean. The name Orphan means a parentless child. In reality, it is a giant spaceship that came to Earth from outer space several decades ago. Its entire hull is also an Organic Engine that artificially generates Organic Energy, the energy that living things possess, and it runs on the energy it generates itself.
Although it is a machine, it has life, and it is now preparing to fly off into the galaxy again while being maintained by the Reclaimers.

Living beings born from the Organic Plates that Orphan produces. Humans can board and control them. There are two kinds of Organic Machine: the Granchers that protect Orphan are the normal form, and the Brain Powerds are considered a variant of them.

A high-density energy crystal developed by the UCE. Its research and development was carried out under OZ's leadership. The energy extracted from this substance has the property of synchronizing with every other energy source and multiplying its power many times over. Its applications are wide-ranging, and it is expected to be put to especially effective use in the military field. The successful development of E2 led to a growing voice for OZ within the UCE.

E2 was developed by UCE research institutions after Duke Dermail joined hands with the Drake Army and obtained technology related to Aura Energy. Duke Dermail's purpose for E2 is to dominate the Earth Sphere by establishing absolute military power, and as a first step, the development of machines enhanced with E2 was pushed forward.
Because it was created with the technology of both Byston Well and the surface world, E2's official name is "Energy Of Two World".

A general term for the UCE's new unmanned machines, developed by applying E2 as a material and as a power source.
(Gnost, Siasi, Harald, etc.)
Thanks to E2's synchronizing effect, their armor and output are strengthened many times over compared with ordinary machines. They are also equipped with the "Mobile Doll System", the unmanned combat program developed by OZ, and they boast performance unmatched by any mobile weapon currently in service.

<Camera Control>
  To move the camera freely, use these controls.
  (Move Camera)
    The camera moves in the direction you tilt the right stick.
  (Reset Camera)
    Hold down the △ button to point the camera in the direction your machine is facing.

<Lock Release>
  To release a lock, hold the △ button a little longer while locked on to an enemy.
  The lock is also released automatically when you tilt the right stick to control the camera.

<Combo>
  A combo is a string of consecutive attacks triggered by entering the □ button or the ○ button in combination during a melee attack. Each follow-up attack has its own properties, such as causing a Stagger or greatly increasing the Chain, so it is effective to pick between them to suit the situation. Depending on the unit, a combo can be from 1 up to 5 attacks long.

<Lock Marker Color>
  (Manual control only)
  The color of the lock marker shows whether the target is within the range of each main weapon.
    Red: within range
    Blue: out of range
  Using your weapons while watching the marker color lets you cut down on wasted ammo.

<Special Attack>
  A special attack is the operation that uses the special weapon mounted on each unit.
    Manual: press the L3 and R3 buttons at the same time
    Semi-Auto: ○ button
  Many special weapons are powerful, but they also have drawbacks such as long reload times, so you need to judge the right moment to use them.

<Target>
  Which enemy gets locked onto first changes with the Lock Type set in Options.
  (Front Priority)
    Your unit locks onto enemies in the direction it is facing first.
  (Camera Priority)
    Your unit locks onto enemies on screen first.

(Distance Priority)
    Your unit locks onto the nearest enemies first.
  (Damage Priority)
    Your unit locks onto the enemies with the lowest armor first.

<Auto-Turn>
  Some weapons have an auto-turn function that automatically turns your unit to face the enemy (the Dunbine, the L-Gaim and others are equipped with these). They let you face the enemy and attack instantly, but if you are dashing, your unit comes to a stop. It is important to understand this trait and use these weapons to suit the situation.

<Weapon Icons>
  The weapon icons show whether each weapon is ready to use.
  (Semi-Auto control)
    The weapons that can fire light up depending on the distance to the locked target. While a weapon is reloading, its icon flashes red.

(Manual control)
    The icon lights up when the locked target is within effective range. While a weapon is reloading, its icon flashes red.

  To keep wasted ammo down, you need to check the weapon icons as you fight.

<Multi-Lock>
  Multi-Lock is a function that lets you lock onto multiple targets at the same time; only some weapons have it. If you hold down the attack button while locked on, the targets within range are locked onto one after another, and releasing the attack button fires a simultaneous attack.

<Chain>
  The Chain is the time window for keeping a string of attacks going. Each hit on an enemy adds to the remaining time, and if you keep landing hits before it runs down to 0, the Chain increases. The Chain affects how many Ace Points you earn, so always keeping it in mind lets you earn more Ace Points.

<Action Button>
  The action button is an operation used under special conditions, such as picking up objects. When you lock onto certain targets, the marker may change to a special shape. When it does, approach within the target's effective range and press the □ button to perform the action that matches the object.

<Special Functions>
  Some units have a special function that affects how they move.
  (Glider Unit)
    Units of this type move forward automatically, like a fighter plane. The Dragonar-1 and others fall into this type.

(Thruster Unit)
    Units of this type can dash while keeping their body turned toward the locked target. The L-Gaim and others fall into this type.

<Stagger>
  Stagger is an effect caused by landing a rapid series of attacks on an enemy within a short time. A staggered enemy is completely defenseless, which gives you a chance to land extra attacks. Some weapons have a high stagger effect and others a low one, so using them selectively makes for effective combat.

If an enemy staggers during a combo, pressing the × button immediately makes your unit close in fast on the staggered enemy, so it becomes even easier to land further attacks. Also, when your own unit is staggered, you can recover from the stagger faster by moving the left stick quickly or by mashing the × button.

<Evasion>
  If you input an evade with the right timing as an enemy attacks, you can dodge its attack. Evading repeatedly is effective when dodging weapons with strong homing, such as missiles, or when you are surrounded by multiple enemies, but it drains your verniers heavily, so be careful.

<Dash Turn>
  A Dash Turn is a move that brings the locked target directly in front of your unit while dashing. Trigger it by pressing the × button twice while dashing. It is useful when you want to face an enemy right away during a dash or when you have circled around behind an enemy, and it is a very important move in high-mobility combat built around dashing.

<Forced Lock Release>
  The areas directly above and below your unit are outside the lock range, so if the locked target moves directly above or below you, the lock is released automatically. To keep a lock-on against fast-moving enemies whose locks are easily broken, it is important to always try to match the enemy's altitude.

<Combat Guidance ①>
  The following methods are effective for landing melee attacks more easily.
(Watch for the moment the enemy stops)
  Every enemy has moments when it leaves an opening, so it is effective to read the enemy's movements while avoiding its attacks and then move in to attack.

(Close in fast with a dash and assault)
  Against enemies that have no strong weapons, it is also effective to close in head-on with a dash and slash them, even at some risk.
(Keep the enemy in check with sub weapons)
  It is also effective to dive in close to the enemy while it is flinching from your sub weapon or other attacks.

<Combat Guidance ②>
  The following methods are effective for dealing with fast-moving enemies.
(Fire a combination of several attacks)
  Single attacks are easy for the enemy to deal with, so using weapons with different properties in succession raises your chances of landing a hit.

(Close in fast with a dash)
  If you can lead from a melee attack into a combo, you can expect heavy damage, so diving in close to the enemy even at some risk can sometimes be the effective tactic.

<Space Combat>
  In space your unit can face in any direction, so space requires different controls from those on the ground.
  (Pitch Up / Pitch Down)
    Tilting the right stick up or down shifts the direction your unit is facing.

(Axis Alignment)
    Pressing the × button twice in a row turns your unit to face the direction of the locked target.

In space combat, you need to make full use of these space-specific controls to fight.

<Charged Shot>
  Weapons capable of a Charged Shot let you adjust their output before firing. Holding down the attack button before firing builds up the output, and the attack fires when you release the attack button. The longer you hold it, the more powerful the attack.

The Mass Production Gespenst Mk-II is the mass-production version of the "Gespenst Mk-II", successor to the very first Personal Trooper. Highly versatile, it excels especially in close-quarters combat. It also carries the Split Missile, a one-hit-kill weapon.

  Pilot: Player
  Height: 21.2 m  Weight: 69.1 t
  Series: Banpresto Original

<Special Weapons>
  Split Missile:
    Launches a container that fires a large number of missiles to attack. It carries 2 of them.

The Cloudbreaker Mass Production Type is a unit dedicated to aerial combat, developed for area suppression. It has a glider-type automatic propulsion function. Its design pursues mobility at the cost of armor, and it is also well equipped with firearms.

  Pilot: Player
  Height: 19 m  Weight: 21.9 t
  Series: From Software Original

<Special Weapons>
  4-Tube Missile Pod:
    Missile pods mounted on both shoulders. Multi-Lock allows them to attack multiple targets.

An Aura Battler from the other world of Byston Well, built with an emphasis on mobility in aerial combat. It has no heavy firepower, but it can move nimbly. It boasts the highest combo count of any unit in this game.

  Pilot: Show Zama
  Height: 6.9 met  Weight: 4.4 lufton
  Series: Aura Battler Dunbine

<Special Weapons>
  Aura Barrier:
    A force field generated around the unit reduces the damage from beam attacks.

The successor to the Dunbine, developed in the Kingdom of Na. It adds powerful weapons and a transformation mechanism, and it also shows tremendous power in ranged combat. In the final battle of the original series, it was given a camouflage paint scheme.

  Pilot: Show Zama
  Height: 8.8 met  Weight: 8.6 lufton
  Series: Aura Battler Dunbine

<Special Weapons>
  Aura Barrier:
    A force field generated around the unit reduces the damage from beam attacks.
  Wing Caliber Transform:
    The unit can transform into the Wing Caliber and fly.

An Aura Battler developed in the Kingdom of Ah. It can be called the final evolution of the heavily armed Aura Battler. Its attack power can change with the pilot's Aura Power.

  Pilot: Black Knight
  Height: 7.9 met  Weight: 7.6 lufton
  Series: Aura Battler Dunbine

<Special Weapons>
  Aura Barrier:
    A force field generated around the unit reduces the damage from beam attacks.
  Aura Power:
    Temporarily raises the unit's attack power through the pilot's Aura Power.

An enhanced unit made by adding many layers of thick armor and boosters to Akito's personal Aestivalis. It is heavily armored, yet its top speed is extremely high.

  Pilot: Akito Tenkawa
  Height: 8.0 m  Weight: -- t
  Series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Prince of Darkness

<Special Weapons>
  Distortion Field:
    A kind of barrier that distorts space to deflect ranged attacks.

A custom-made version of the Aestivalis, the humanoid close-combat weapon developed by Nergal Heavy Industries. It is equipped with a Distortion Field.

  Pilot: Ryoko Subaru
  Height: 6.0 m  Weight: -- t
  Series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Prince of Darkness

<Special Weapons>
  Distortion Field:
    A kind of barrier that distorts space to deflect ranged attacks.

A new mobile weapon developed by Nergal Heavy Industries. Its only weapons are the attack claws on both hands, and its design is specialized for close combat.

  Pilot: Genichiro Tsukiomi
  Height: 6.0 m  Weight: -- t
  Series: Martian Successor Nadesico: The Prince of Darkness

<Special Weapons>
  Distortion Field:
    A kind of barrier that distorts space to deflect ranged attacks.

A second-generation prototype SPT developed on planet Grados. It operates through dialogue with Rei, the main computer built into the unit. It is equipped with the danger-evasion system "V-MAX".

  Pilot: Albatro Nul Eiji Asuka
  Height: 9.52 m  Weight: 13.75 t
  Series: Blue Comet SPT Layzner

<Special Weapons>
  V-MAX Activate:
    An emergency system that becomes available when the unit's armor drops to 30 percent or less. It temporarily boosts the Layzner's performance and allows it to make ramming assaults.
  ECM Chaff:
    Scatters metal fragments to jam radio waves and throw off the homing of missiles.

A golden SPT developed by the Gradosian Army. It carries an advanced main computer, which lets its pilot activate V-MAX at will.

  Pilot: Le Cain
  Height: 11.82 m  Weight: 16.03 t
  Series: Blue Comet SPT Layzner

<Special Weapons>
  V-MAX Activate:
    Temporarily boosts the Zakaal's performance and allows it to make ramming assaults.

An Organic Machine born from an Organic Plate produced by Orphan. Because it is a kind of living organism with its own self-sustaining tissue, its performance changes with its mood.

  Pilot: Yuu Isami
  Height: -- m  Weight: -- t
  Series: Brain Powerd

<Special Weapons>
  Chakra Shield:
    Puts up a shield around the unit, reducing the damage from both solid-ammo attacks and beam attacks.

An Organic Machine born from an Organic Plate produced by Orphan. Because it is a kind of living organism with its own self-sustaining tissue, its performance changes with its mood.

  Pilot: Hime Utsunomiya
  Height: -- m  Weight: -- t
  Series: Brain Powerd

<Special Weapons>
  Chakra Shield:
    Puts up a shield around the unit, reducing the damage from both solid-ammo attacks and beam attacks.

A Brain Powerd reborn when the Yuu Brain fused with Nelly Kim's Brain. Since it is a kind of life form with self-sustaining tissue, its performance changes with its mood.

  Pilot: Yuu Isami
  Height: -- m  Weight: -- t
  Series: Brain Powerd

<Special Weapons>
  Chakra Shield:
    Raises a shield around the machine that reduces damage from solid-projectile and beam attacks.

An aberrant, mutant Grancher that has evolved differently from ordinary Granchers. It can freely extend and retract the fins on both shoulders and use them as weapons.

  Pilot: Jonathan Green
  Height: -- m  Weight: -- t
  Series: Brain Powerd

<Special Weapons>
  Fin (Morphing):
    Extends and retracts the fins to strike directly. Multi-Lock allows it to attack several enemies at once.

<Special Weapons>
  Chakra Light All Fire:
    Fires Chakra Light from the tips of the fins. Charging adjusts how many fins are deployed.
  Chakra Shield:
    Raises a shield around the machine that reduces damage from solid-projectile and beam attacks.

A Gundam developed by Doctor J. A transformable machine that excels at high-speed movement and disengaging. It carries a Buster Rifle that can destroy a target in a single shot.

  Pilot: Heero Yuy
  Height: 16.3 m  Weight: 7.1 t
  Series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing

<Special Weapons>
  Bird Mode:
    Transforms into Bird Mode and flies.

A Gundam developed by Professor G. Its equipment is built mainly for covert missions, and it carries a Hyper Jammer as standard. It excels at close combat with its large Beam Scythe.

  Pilot: Duo Maxwell
  Height: 16.3 m  Weight: 7.2 t
  Series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing

<Special Weapons>
  Hyper Jammer:
    Uses an electronic jamming device to evade enemy lock-on for a set time.

A Gundam developed by Doktor S. Heavy weapons mounted all over its body give it overwhelming firepower. It can perform a Full Open Attack, firing all of its weapons at once.

  Pilot: Trowa Barton
  Height: 16.7 m  Weight: 7.7 t
  Series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing

<Special Weapons>
  Micro Missile:
    Missile pods built into both shoulders. Multi-Lock allows it to attack several enemies at once.

A Gundam developed by Instructor H. It is designed with an emphasis on hand-to-hand combat, and its Heat Shotel attacks are extremely powerful. It also has thick armor, which suits it to close-quarters fighting.

  Pilot: Quatre Raberba Winner
  Height: 16.5 m  Weight: 7.5 t
  Series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing

<Special Weapons>
  Shield Flash:
    Uses a flash built into the shield to stagger nearby enemies or stop them in their tracks.

A Gundam developed by Master O. It goes by the nickname "Nataku". Its close-range attacks are many and powerful, but it is not suited to long-range combat.

  Pilot: Chang Wufei
  Height: 16.4 m  Weight: 7.4 t
  Series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing

A mobile suit designed to carry out operations on its own. It has overwhelming output, but its verniers burn through boost extremely quickly, so it demands advanced piloting skill.

  Pilot: Zechs Merquise
  Height: 17.4 m  Weight: 8.8 t
  Series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing

A dueling mobile suit whose design philosophy is the spirit of chivalry. It has no ranged weapons at all, but it is overwhelmingly powerful in close combat. It can also make surprise attacks in Bird Mode.

  Pilot: Zechs Merquise
  Height: 17.4 m  Weight: 8.5 t
  Series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing

<Special Weapons>
  Bird Mode:
    Transforms into Bird Mode and flies.

A Metal Armor developed by the Giganos Empire. Its Lifter gives it automatic propulsion. In space battles it equips the Cavalier, special armor carrying powerful twin railcannons.

  Pilot: Kain Wakaba
  Height: 17.5 m  Weight: 61.5 t
  Series: Metal Armor Dragonar

<Special Weapons>
  5-Tube Missile Launcher (Earth):
    Missile launchers mounted on both wings. Multi-Lock allows it to attack several enemies at once.
  Cavalier (Space):
    Detaches the equipped Cavalier. It deals damage if it hits an enemy.

A Metal Armor developed by the Giganos Empire. A high-firepower machine built for long-range support, but poor mobility makes it unsuited to close combat. Its equipment differs on the ground and in space.

  Pilot: Tapp Oceano
  Height: 16.8 m  Weight: 110.2 t
  Series: Metal Armor Dragonar

<Special Weapons>
  10-Tube Missile Launcher (Earth):
    Missile launchers mounted on both wings. Multi-Lock allows it to attack several enemies at once.

A Metal Armor developed by the Giganos Empire. Built mainly for reconnaissance and electronic warfare, it has excellent mobility and jamming performance. Its equipment differs on the ground and in space.

  Pilot: Light Newman
  Height: 18.2 m  Weight: 44.5 t
  Series: Metal Armor Dragonar

<Special Weapons>
  Jammer:
    Interferes with enemy electronics. While it is active, enemy missiles have no effect.

A super-large Metal Armor built by Giganos. A heavily armed machine with overwhelming firepower and armor. It carries a thought control system that controls the machine directly from the pilot's brain waves.

  Pilot: Gun Jem
  Height: 28.3 m  Weight: -- t
  Series: Metal Armor Dragonar

<Special Weapons>
  Large Cruise Missile:
    Fires a huge long-range missile. Its destructive power is immense, but it carries only one.

A transformable mobile suit developed by Anaheim Electronics from a basic design by Kamille Bidan. A machine well balanced in both offense and defense.

  Pilot: Kamille Bidan
  Height: 19.85 m  Weight: 28.7 t
  Series: Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam

<Special Weapons>
  Wave Rider Transform:
